install.windows: Download the Windows installer from https://www.workbuddy.ai/ and follow the install wizard.
install.macos: Download the macOS installer from https://www.workbuddy.ai/ and move WorkBuddy AI.app to Applications.
install.note: International edition, separate from WorkBuddy (China). Do not install Tencent.WorkBuddy as a substitute.

identity_guard.description: WorkBuddy AI is the international desktop app. Windows executable: WorkBuddyAI.exe. Config directory: ~/.workbuddy-ai. Keep independent from the domestic WorkBuddy app.
